newsitem.title: GERMANY: Merck says expects significant 97 earnings growth.
newsitem.headline: Merck says expects significant 97 earnings growth.

text.p: German pharmaceuticals group Merck KGaA said on Tuesday that its current earnings growth was positive and it expected to report significant earnings growth again in 1997.

Merck Management Board Chairman Hans Joachim Langmann gave no concrete projections, but told a news conference that if sales registered double-digit growth, then profits would also see double-digit growth.
Langmann did not give a dividend outlook for 1997, but said that Merck followed a "shareholder-friendly" route.
Earlier, Merck said its profits surged 36 percent and said the current business year had started well.
